full_prompt_en: A square sepia-toned drawing shows a seated man beneath the spreading branches of a large tree. The pale parchment-colored background carries a dense web of slender leafless twigs, while the thick trunk and main limbs rise behind his shoulders. He sits slightly left of center on a low dark base, facing the viewer with his head turned toward the left. His expression is serious and attentive, with strongly drawn eyes, cheekbones, and mouth. A dark broad jacket hangs loosely from his shoulders over a pale high-collared shirt and darker vest. Light trousers bend across his lap and extend toward the lower right, their creases described by narrow shadows and fine hatch marks. One hand rests over his knee, while the other sits near a thin cane or curved handle at his right side. The tree's branching network remains pale and intricate behind him, giving the figure a textured setting without competing with his dark silhouette. Across the jacket, layered charcoal-like marks and precise crosshatching build substantial weight; highlights are left as warm paper tone. The face and hands have a more careful tonal range, shifting through cream, tan, and deep brown. Diffuse light from the upper left brightens the shirt, knee, and forehead, while the coat folds and the area below the seat deepen into shadow. The overall composition is dignified and grounded, balancing a monumental dark figure against delicate organic linework and a restrained antique-brown palette.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形棕褐色调素描，一位男子坐在大树伸展的枝干之下。浅羊皮纸色背景上布满纤细的无叶小枝，粗树干和主枝从他肩后升起。他坐在中央略偏左的低矮深色基座上，身体面对观者，头转向左侧。神情严肃而专注，眼睛、颧骨和嘴部都经过有力描绘。深色宽外套松松搭在肩上，里面是浅色高领衬衫和更深色马甲。浅色长裤弯过大腿，向右下延伸，褶皱由细窄阴影和纤细排线刻画。一只手停在膝上，另一只位于右侧细手杖或弯柄附近。树枝网络在身后保持浅淡而精巧，为人物提供有纹理的背景，却不与深色剪影争夺注意力。外套上的层叠炭笔般痕迹和精确交叉排线建立厚重感；高光则保留暖纸本色。脸和手的明暗更仔细，在奶油色、棕褐色和深褐色之间过渡。来自左上方的漫射光提亮衬衫、膝部与额头，外套褶皱和座位下方则沉入阴影。整体构图庄重而稳定，让宏大的深色人物与纤细有机线条、克制的旧棕色系互相平衡。
style_prompt_en: The drawing uses a restricted warm sepia range and highly controlled tonal draftsmanship. Fine hatching and crosshatching turn pale paper into soft midtones, while densely layered dark marks create weight and focal contrast. Broad shapes are carefully modeled, but their edges can merge gently with surrounding textured fields. Delicate branching linear networks occupy lighter space around the denser central mass, balancing intricate detail with strong value organization. Highlights come largely from exposed cream paper rather than bright applied pigment. Diffuse upper-side light produces gradual modeling, deep folded shadows, and a dignified sense of volume. The surface has an aged, fibrous character that supports the hand-drawn marks without obscuring them.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅绘图采用克制的暖棕褐色域与高度受控的明暗素描。细排线和交叉排线把浅纸面转化为柔和中间调，密集叠加的深色笔痕则建立重量与焦点对比。宽大形体经过仔细塑形，但边缘可以温和融入周围带纹理的区域。纤细分叉线网占据较浅空间，围绕更密实的中央团块，使精巧细节与强烈明度组织保持平衡。高光主要来自外露的奶油色纸面，而非明亮附加颜料。上方一侧的漫射光产生渐进塑形、深暗褶皱阴影和庄重体积感。表面带有陈旧纤维质地，承托手绘痕迹而不遮蔽它们。
theme_en: A seated man beneath the branching limbs of a tree
theme_zh: 坐在树木分叉枝干下的男子
name: Charles White
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
